notes.title: Discontinuation of Russian Language Support and Apology
notes.content:
Today's version 1.1.6 update includes a major change, the removal of Russian from the list of supported languages, alongside minor bug fixes.

Until now, I have used machine translation to localize the game, driven by a desire to have as many people as possible enjoy my work. Initially, the game supported Japanese and machine-translated English, and in the recent version 1.1.5, Russian was added.

While I did my best to review the English translation, I had no knowledge of Russian, so I regretfully used the machine-translated text as is. As I have become accustomed to reading with machine translation myself, I believed that having more language options would be better, and I still hold this belief. However, I also feared that the translation quality might be poor.

Recently, I received feedback from a user pointing out that the Russian text contained discriminatory expressions.

I have always understood that, even if words appear equivalent across languages, differences in linguistic systems and cultural backgrounds prevent them from fully conveying the same meaning. Additionally, I recognize that a language’s unique context and emotional nuance can impact its interpretation, and that “localization” is not just about translating text.

In this case, however, the issue goes beyond mere language conversion or localization. Certain words in the translation carried discriminatory meanings with strong political connotations, which was never my intention.

To anyone who was hurt or offended by this, I offer my sincerest apologies.

Sincerely,  
Kittypool, Developer of GEARS STORY

notes.title: 1.1.5 Fixed Achievement Bug
notes.content:
I apologize for the bug not being fixed despite the repeated updates over the past few times.

I regret the prolonged inconvenience, but the "Steam achievement not unlocking bug" has been completely fixed this time.

If you have already seen the ending, the achievements will be unlocked on the title screen.

notes.title: Mini-Game Skip & Russian Language Support & more!
notes.content:

[h1]Mini-Game Skip Feature[/h1]

The mini-games, long criticized for their redundancy, can finally be skipped.

The function of the highest-priced item, the "Golden Wrench", has been changed as follows:
[list][*]Before: The path to the goal is visualized for 100 moves.
[*]After: Becomes inoperable and automatically moves to the goal.[/list]

notes.title: Release! and notes
notes.content:
After 108 days of development, "Gears Story" is finally released!

For those who [b]haven't purchased it yet[/b], those who [b]have already purchased it and are about to play[/b], and even those who [b]have already finished it[/b], there's something I want to share.


[h1]Conclusion: The price of this game will not increase[/h1]

This game includes an "Afterword," and it seems that the way I wrote it was a bit confusing, leading to some misunderstandings among some players.

I wrote the following in the Afterword:

[quote]The next installment, "Shoe-Straings Story," will of course share the same universe and is expected to be more than ten times larger in scale. [b]Accordingly, we plan to revise the pricing[/b], and it will take some time before release.[/quote]

This does [u][b]NOT mean that "Gears Story" is scheduled for a price increase[/b][/u].

It simply means, "While we released this work at $0.99, the lowest price possible on Steam, the next work, 'Shoe-Strings Story,' will be a bit more expensive." [b]The price of "Gears Story" will continue to be offered at $0.99[/b].

I apologize for any confusion my unclear wording may have caused!!


[h1]That being said, enjoy the game![/h1]

Based on the store page, this game might seem like a serious novel game.

However, I intended to structure the story so that it could be enjoyed by anyone, much like a pop Hollywood movie.

It's sprinkled with humor throughout, interspersed with serious developments, and ends with a surprising climax.


[h1]It's a shame to just stack it![/h1]

For those still hesitating to buy or considering stacking it, I'll give a small spoiler to nudge you: in this game, there's a scene where the protagonist [spoiler]trips on hallucinogenic drugs[/spoiler]!

There are no direct sexual depictions, violent scenes, or grotesque portrayals, so everyone can play with peace of mind. I would be delighted if you could try playing it at least once.

Once again, I sincerely hope you enjoy my work, "Gears Story".
